2608.02986.title: Internalising the Identity Primitive: Cryptographic Individuality for an Autonomous Agent on a Public Blockchain
2608.02986.paper_summary: A software agent on a public blockchain accumulates authority and economic stakes, raising the engineering question of what makes it count as an individual. The paper's central contribution is a shift of trust root for the key-to-weights binding of agent identity: from hardware, operator, or wrapper trust to cryptographic assumptions enforced by a pinned implementation (liveness, key custody, oracle trust, and the underlying software stack remain external). We design and deploy on Solana devnet an agent whose neural-network weights are a deterministic function of its private key. The binding is committed in zero knowledge at genesis, re-checked against that commitment at every state transition, and signed by the agent into an on-chain history unforkable once finalized; in a PoC-tier extension, a protocol-imposed metabolic cost is debited each cycle from a key-derived economic account, adding a consumption-side economic-viability constraint to the key-history-economy triple. Empirically, the agent completes a 2.36-day on-chain run with two host-side resumptions but no rejected transition, at bounded per-transition verification cost; a substituted substrate is rejected on chain, and independently keyed agents diverge as predicted while a same-key control stays at zero. To our knowledge, this is the first published on-chain agent whose identity primitive is itself a cryptographic invariant re-checked at every state transition. The resulting transition-time invariant instantiates the cryptographic individuality proposed by Suzuki 2026's Artificial Externality framework.
2608.02986.paper_summary_zh: 一個在公共區塊鏈上的軟體代理累積了權威和經濟利益，提出了什麼使其被視為個體的工程問題。本文的核心貢獻是將代理身份的鍵與權重綁定的信任根從硬體、操作員或包裝者信任轉變為由固定實現強制的密碼學假設（活性、密鑰保管、預言機信任以及基礎軟體堆棧仍然是外部的）。我們在 Solana devnet 上設計並部署了一個代理，其神經網路權重是其私鑰的確定性函數。該綁定在創世時以零知識方式提交，在每次狀態轉換時重新檢查該承諾，並由代理簽署進入一個一旦確定便無法分叉的鏈上歷史；在一個 PoC 級別的擴展中，每個周期從一個基於密鑰的經濟賬戶中扣除協議強加的代謝成本，為鍵-歷史-經濟三元組增加了一個消費端的經濟可行性約束。根據實證，該代理完成了一次 2.36 天的鏈上運行，期間有兩次主機端的恢復，但沒有拒絕的轉換，且每次轉換的驗證成本是有界的；一個替代的基底在鏈上被拒絕，而獨立鍵控的代理如預測般發散，而同鍵控制保持在零。據我們所知，這是第一個發表的鏈上代理，其身份原語本身是一個在每次狀態轉換時重新檢查的密碼學不變量。由此產生的轉換時間不變量實現了 Suzuki 2026 年的人工外部性框架所提出的密碼學個體性。
2608.02986.author: Keisuke Suzuki et.al.
